paras: Galvarinus tarmensis, also known commonly as the slender snake, is a species of venomous snake in the subfamily Dipsadinae of the family Colubridae. The species is endemic to Peru.
Galvarinus tarmensis is found in the central highlands of Peru, in Junín region.
The preferred natural habitats of Galvarinus tarmensis are forest and shrubland, at elevations around 3,200 m (10,500 ft).
